description_en: Queries the traffic statistics list of a gateway by calling ListGatewayTransferFlowStats
description_zh: 调用ListGatewayTransferFlowStats查询网关流量统计列表
name: ListGatewayTransferFlowStats

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，以毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，以毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the time interval. Valid values:

INTERVAL_IN_HOURS: statistics collected by hour
INTERVAL_IN_DAYS: statistics collected by day
parameters.help_zh:
时间间隔的单位，可取值为：

INTERVAL_IN_HOURS：按照小时统计
INTERVAL_IN_DAYS：按照天统计
parameters.name: time_interval_unit
